title: [29.x] Subcontractor Price ignores Run Time when creating purchase cost for time-based subcontracting operations
summary: Subcontractor price calculation for time-based operations now correctly multiplies the unit cost by the operation's run time factor when creating purchase requisitions and orders.
key_points: Subcontractor price for Time-based operations ignored the routing line's operation time factor
New shared calculation multiplies the subcontractor price by the operation time factor and rounds to the unit-amount precision
Applied to requisition worksheet lines, carried-out purchase lines, automatic repricing and directly created purchase lines
Automated test added covering those pricing scenarios
Fixes an incorrect Direct Unit Cost on subcontracting purchase and requisition lines
quote: The operation's run time was not included, resulting in an incorrect Direct Unit Cost on requisition worksheet and purchase lines.
